module.purpose: Provides the server-rendered team settings page and its metadata for a specific team route.
module.summary: This page composes localized settings metadata with a settings header and the team settings view. It receives the team identifier through the route metadata path, resolves translations asynchronously, and renders the team settings interface without defining local state or business logic.
module.businessContext: Supports team administrators configuring team-level settings. Failure prevents access to the team settings page and its descriptive metadata.
functions: generateMetadata (~L6-12): Builds localized metadata for the team settings route
Page (~L14-24): Renders the localized team settings page layout

contractsProvided.name: Page

edgeCases.inputShape: Route parameters contain a team identifier
edgeCases.behavior: The identifier is awaited and interpolated into the metadata URL path.

edgeCases.inputShape: Translation lookup is unavailable or rejects
edgeCases.behavior: No local fallback or error handling is provided; the asynchronous operation propagates failure.

invariants.description: Translation retrieval completes before the page renders localized title and description values.
The team settings view is always rendered as a child of the settings header.

assumptions.description: The framework supplies route parameters through a promise containing a string team identifier.
The translation namespace contains settings and team_settings_description keys.
Imported metadata, translation, header, and team settings modules are initialized before page execution.

units.name: generateMetadata
units.source:
export const generateMetadata = async ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) =>
  await _generateMetadata(
    (t) => t("settings"),
    (t) => t("team_settings_description"),
    undefined,
    undefined,
    `/settings/teams/${(await params).id}/settings`

detail.name: generateMetadata
detail.signature: export const generateMetadata = async ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) =>
preconditions: The params promise resolves to an object containing a string id.
postconditions: The metadata-generation call receives a path of the form /settings/teams/{id}/settings using the resolved params.id.
invariants: The settings title translation key is always settings.
The team settings description translation key is always team_settings_description.
The params promise is awaited before constructing the team-settings path.
edgeCases: If params resolves with an empty id, the generated path contains an empty identifier segment: /settings/teams//settings.
If params rejects, or _generateMetadata rejects, the rejection propagates to the caller.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; invalid values or promise rejection propagate through the async result.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns the Promise result of _generateMetadata invoked with title and description translation callbacks, two undefined arguments, and a route path string formatted as /settings/teams/{resolved params.id}/settings.
detail.summary: Asynchronously generates team-settings page metadata using the settings translation keys and a URL containing the resolved team identifier.

specLiterals.role: Translation key supplied for the metadata title.
Translation key supplied for the metadata description.
Route template used as the metadata URL path.

specTests.then: _generateMetadata is called with translation callbacks for settings and team_settings_description, two undefined arguments, and the path /settings/teams/abc/settings; the returned metadata result is forwarded.
The resulting promise rejects with the same error and no metadata fallback is produced.

units.name: Page

detail.name: Page
postconditions: Resolves to a SettingsHeader containing translated settings title and team settings description, with TeamSettingsView as its child.
The rendered SettingsHeader receives borderInShellHeader set to false.
invariants: The settings title translation key is "settings".
The team settings description translation key is "team_settings_description".
The TeamSettingsView is rendered inside SettingsHeader.
edgeCases: If getTranslate rejects, the page promise rejects and no page element is returned.
If either translation lookup yields an unavailable or empty value, that value is passed through to SettingsHeader without local fallback.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: No local error value; failures from getTranslate propagate as a rejected promise.

detail.summary: Asynchronously prepares the translation function and renders the team settings page within a settings header. The header uses translated title and description text and contains the team settings view.

specLiterals.role: Translation key used for the settings header title.
Translation key used for the settings header description.
Disables the shell-header border for the settings header.

specTests.then: The result renders SettingsHeader with the translated title and description, borderInShellHeader false, and TeamSettingsView as its child.
The returned promise rejects with the same failure rather than returning a fallback element.
